description: Get natural-hazard risk for a US lat/lon from the FEMA National Risk Index: flood, wildfire, hurricane, earthquake, heat, drought, tornado and more.

lat.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90, required), e.g. 33.45

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

lon.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, required), e.g. -112.07

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

name: get_disaster_risk
title: Get Disaster Risk
